prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production PNG background layer for PTK-002 Phi Ta Khon 2.5D WebAR: a miniature illustrated FOREST theatre backdrop, NOT a mockup or a full environment screenshot. Landscape1536x1024 canvas, true transparent background. Front orthographic elevation, a continuous flat paper-theatre cutout with a straight shared ground baseline at 88 percent image height and transparent margin below. Gentle lush forest: layered muted olive/sage/deep-green foliage, slender natural tree trunks on left and right, a little soft distant greenery. Dense enough that it reads clearly as being in a forest; open quiet clearing in the center so a brown-costumed character stands out. Side trees rise higher than the central distant shrubs; mild canopy framing at the upper sides, but do not enclose entire canvas in a solid rectangular green sky. Silhouette follows individual leaves and tree crowns with alpha around it. No floating loose disconnected objects above frame. Palette complementary to the reference character's rusty brown costume: natural forest greens, warm bark, subdued cream highlights. Style matches the hand-inked 2D character: clean dark-brown outlines, restrained cel shading and light painted texture, readable broad shapes instead of thousands of tiny leaves. Reference image is character style/palette guidance only; do NOT draw the character or mask. No foreground layer, no figure, no wildlife, no temple, no mountains, no text, no border, no UI, no postcard, no stage base, no cast shadow or glow. Keep all trees fully inside canvas with clear side/top margin. Single isolated upright backdrop, usable as one transparent textured plane.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production WebAR texture: ONE circular patch of forest clearing ground seen EXACTLY straight down, orthographic TOP VIEW. Square 1024x1024 transparent PNG, perfect circular disc with clear 6 percent transparent padding outside on all sides. Warm light brown packed earth center, restrained fine soil texture, a handful of small muted olive leaves and small flat pebbles near perimeter, soft irregular grass/fern tufts confined to thin outer edge, but maintain broadly circular footprint. Open quiet bare-earth center for a standing character. Match hand-inked lightly textured 2D illustration style with muted olive/sage forest greens and rusty brown costume palette. This is a horizontal flat texture which becomes an ellipse through AR perspective; NO baked perspective, NO vertical stage wall, NO raised wooden rim, NO platform bevel, NO horizon, NO trees or upright trunks, NO character, NO footprint, NO text, NO cast shadow, NO glow, NO UI or postcard. Actual alpha outside disc and between fringe leaves, no brown/green haze. Natural modest forest-floor stage, not ornate theatrical podium.
